content: Hello! How can I assist you with your account or payroll details today?
Hi, I just wanted to confirm that my recent direct deposit was processed. My employee ID is 442819 and my bank is Wells Fargo.

Absolutely, let me review the records. I see a payroll deposit for $2,340.15 sent to your Wells Fargo account ending in 6083 under the name Leslie Martinez. The transaction was completed via ACH transfer on June 12th at 9:14 AM, with reference ID WF-PAY-20240612-0332. Is this the deposit you're referring to?
Yes, that matches. But I haven't seen it show up in my account yet. Should I be worried?

Not to worry, Leslie. ACH transfers can sometimes take up to 24 hours to reflect, especially if processed after 9 AM. Since your transaction (WF-PAY-20240612-0332) was sent this morning, it should appear by end of day or early tomorrow.
Thanks. I'm traveling tomorrow and need to be sure the funds arrive before my flight at 6 AM.

Understood, given your early flight, it's important. If the deposit hasn't posted in your Wells Fargo account ending 6083 by midnight, please email payroll@marstonhr.com with a screenshot of your account summary. We'll escalate immediately to ensure there are no delays for you.
Perfect, thank you for confirming. I'll keep an eye on it tonight.

You're welcome, Leslie. For reference, your employee ID 442819 and transaction ID WF-PAY-20240612-0332 are linked, so any updates will be tracked. Safe travels tomorrow, and don't hesitate to reach out if you need urgent assistance.
